content.intro: In this lesson, you will study useFormStatus as part of Modern React Actions, Concurrency, and Form APIs. The syllabus topics are kept below, then connected to a small example you can inspect and adapt.
content.why_it_matters: Reading the parent form's status connects React to remote data that can fail or change independently. Check HTTP status, model loading/success/empty/error states, and prevent obsolete work from overwriting newer user intent.
